svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.4 STRUCTURAL REQUIREMENTS

g.text: Obstructions such as parapets are not spaced closer than Do, in m.
Ho obstruction height, m · Ss ground snow load, kPa ·
γ = 4.0 kN/m³ or 0.43 Ss + 2.2 kN/m³, whichever is lesser

svg.text: Wall, floor and roof planes made of frames of
small repetitive structural members, where all of
Roof and wall planes clad, sheathed or braced
The area counts adjoining buildings even where
Flat roofs: no significant obstructions closer
Do = 10(Ho − 0.8Ss/γ), with γ the specific weight
Drawn: roof trusses at the spacing and span limits on stud walls. The formula is copied from the Article.
